key_entities: AssertionError: clones do not share a base
propositions: The _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(..., 'list') pattern at 23 sites relies on best-effort sync that silently fails under CI load, causing flaky setup failures with misleading error messages.
Eight sites use the sync result as a fixture precondition (lines 378, 398, 460, 1236, 1325, 1333, 1476, 1580) where one clone must be strictly behind and a deterministic fetch+merge is load-bearing.

Fifteen sites (lines 225, 229, 319, 321, 343, 345, 469, 471, 507, 1085, 1117, 1242, 1339, 1505, 1507) test reconvergence through the production read path; the read-sync failure is a true signal not a setup artifact.
The 8 precondition sites must be converted to _sync_from_origin (checked fetch + checked ff-only merge) to ensure deterministic setup.
A third category of raw _git(push, ...) calls with check=True are fail-fast and outside this flake mechanism, requiring separate investigation.
